before: A separate installed FinData Toolkit Skill packages market-data acquisition scripts and their usage instructions. In the tested path, the agent invokes its stock-history script through the runtime's generic `exec` tool, receives dated daily bars and a source URL, and then uses a native finance-tool call to persist a research artifact. The Skill contains instructions and scripts. The `exec` tool runs the script, and the finance plugin manages the tenant-scoped thesis ledger. before: An online AMD case exercised a longer path in one isolated Go Gateway session. The agent invoked an installed FinData Toolkit Skill through the execution tool to obtain five dated Nasdaq daily bars, made a second execution call for arithmetic, and saved a preliminary research thesis through the finance plugin. The first and latest closes were 570.82 on 14 October 2026 and 534.74 on 20 October 2026. Recalculation gives a first-to-latest change of −6.3207%. The saved evidence includes the source URL, dates, closing prices, bar interval, and rounded result of −6.32%. The payload did not specify currency or adjustment basis, so USD was explicitly an inference.
